**Open resources for advanced Excel pivot tables — for transition to data analyst:**

* **Microsoft Office/Create a Pivot Table — Wikibooks**
  https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Microsoft_Office/Create_a_Pivot_Table
  Teaches how to create a pivot table by choosing a data table and dragging headers into Row and Data areas.

* **3.4 Introduction to PivotTables – Introduction to Excel for Business Data**
  https://openoregon.pressbooks.pub/introductiontoexcel/chapter/3-4-introduction-to-pivottables-2/
  Teaches how PivotTables summarize a dataset while leaving the original dataset unchanged.

* **Chapter 18: Pivot Tables – MS Excel Bootcamp**
  https://openwa.pressbooks.pub/msexcelbootcamp/chapter/chapter-18-pivot-tables/
  Teaches pivot-table concepts including Rows, Columns, Values and Filters areas and Value calculations like SUM, COUNT and AVERAGE.

* **7.1: PivotTables/Charts – Business Data Reporting**
  https://biz.libretexts.org/@api/deki/pages/150607/pdf/7.1%253A%2bPivotTables%252FCharts.pdf
  Teaches advanced features to manipulate calculated fields, add slicers and use timelines in a PivotTable.

* **3 Advanced – Advanced Formulas, Functions and Macros – Excel**
  https://spscc.pressbooks.pub/begtointermedexcel/?p=226
  Teaches how PivotTable reports, PivotChart reports, trendlines and slicers support analysis of large amounts of data.
